build_pspnet_encoder: build a PSPNet encoder model with pyramid pooling and multi-scale feature projections for visual correspondence
build_pspnet_small_encoder: build a smaller PSPNet encoder that returns four feature levels instead of five for lighter computation
build_bfmodule_head: build a binary feature module head that produces multi-scale predictions from input feature maps
compute_geo_costs: compute geometric correspondence costs including Sampson error and angular metrics from homography and essential matrix
run_ransac_essential_matrix: run RANSAC to estimate essential matrix and recover rotation and translation from point correspondences
